QuestInfo.name: The Last Gift
QuestInfo.0: Moonbeam forgot about you. She doesn't even remember what happened to her spirits. Talk to her a little more.
QuestInfo.1: Moonbeam says she prays to the Fox God every day, asking for her spirits back. Maybe it will grant you that wish if you pray? Make a wish to the Fox God.
QuestInfo.2: Moonbeam thinks her spirits left her because she behaved badly. You tried to give them back, but the spirits will not leave you. Did they forget as well?

0.msg: You know, you're very weird. I doubt you fit in anywhere. Maybe... I'm like you. The other foxes don't like me because I don't have a spirit of my own. I mean, I used to, but then it... disappeared.

1.msg: I don't even remember it happening. I think the Fox God must have taken it away from me because I behaved so badly. So, I pray to the Fox God every day. I'm praying to become a good fox so I can have my spirit back.

yes.0: Hmm... You are not a fox, so the Fox God might not grant your wish... But who knows? The Fox God is a tricky one. Couldn't hurt to try. Here, put your hands together like this, close your eyes, and say... Dear Fox God, my Fox God. Please grant my wish. My wish is...

no.0: Hmm... You are not a fox, so the Fox God might not grant your wish...

1.0: Even the foxes have forgotten about me. No one will ever remember me, no matter where I go. It's... it's too cruel.
1.1: I don't belong in Maple World or Grandis. There's nowhere for me. What's the point? Why do I exist?

default.0: Put your hands together like this and say it with your eyes closed. Dear Fox God, my Fox God. Please grant my wish.
